fact: Law modifying and completing law 2004-21 on the organisation of statistical activities was made at Dakar in January 2012, adding the statistical visa, data transmission to ANSD and access to anonymised individual data.
title: Loi modifiant et complétant la loi n° 2004-21 du 21 juillet 2004 portant organisation des activités statistiques
